settings.text: Sourced, blended, roasted, ground and packed in Jordan

settings.heading: Our Story
settings.body: Small-batch roasting, and a big, bold flavour. Fresh, ethically sourced coffee from bean to brew, delivered straight to your door.

settings.image_alt: Coffee beans and cupping bowls prepared for tasting
settings.title: Sourcing
settings.body: We buy green coffee for the blend it has to become, and we buy it from the same growers year after year.

settings.image_alt: Roasted coffee falling from the roaster into the cooling tray
settings.title: Roasting
settings.body: Roasted in our own facility in Jordan, to a profile we develop with you and hold to from the first batch to the hundredth.
settings.link_label: See what we can roast for you

settings.image_alt: Silver pouches showing different example private label coffee brands
settings.title: Packing
settings.body: Ground to your grind, filled to your weight and sealed in your bag. Whole bean, ground, or a full private-label range.

settings.heading: Taste it before you commit.
settings.body: Tell us the coffee your business needs and we will roast a sample set to match it.
